subject: Kickoff - discrete diffusion for structured record generation
body:
Team,

Kicking off D3PM. Our open-source release does denoising diffusion in discrete state spaces, with structured transition matrices rather than Gaussian noise, and it ships three tracks: image space evaluated in bits-per-dimension, text space, and the insertion/deletion variant from the follow-up work.

What I want out of it is the text and categorical side. We generate synthetic records constantly - for testing, for privacy-preserving sharing - and autoregressive generation is slow and produces suspiciously fluent garbage. A diffusion process over discrete states can be conditioned on partial records and refines the whole record in parallel.

Mar 2 - Jun 15:
- Mar 27: image track reproduced, bits-per-dimension matching the paper. This is our sanity check, not the goal.
- Apr 30: text track running on our schema-constrained record corpus.
- Jun 5: quality + speed comparison vs our autoregressive generator.

Deshawn on staffing, Carmen tech lead. FID/IS are not available in the release, so plan evaluation around bits-per-dimension and our own metrics.

Dmitri
